routine.title: Three easy steps, every day
routine.lead: A simple order to follow, morning and night. Swap in what your skin asks for.

stepOne.title: Cleanse
stepOne.body: Start fresh with a gentle wash that leaves skin clean and calm.

stepTwo.title: Treat
stepTwo.body: Layer what your skin needs today: a serum, an essence or a mask.

stepThree.title: Protect
stepThree.body: Seal it in with a moisturiser, and finish with sun care by day.

routine.alt: A woman smoothing cream onto her cheek
